title: Cross-file changes required when extending a core tsdb datasource
answers: What else do I need to update when adding a field to a datasource query model?
What must change together when adding a new core datasource constructor?
Why is there a .cue file next to a generated Go query type?
body:
1) Query schema: Go types under `<pkg>/kinds/dataquery/types_dataquery_gen.go` are generated ("Code generated - EDITING IS FUTILE") from the CUE file at public/app/plugins/datasource/<name>/dataquery.cue via `make gen-cue` — edit the .cue, regenerate both Go and TS types, don't hand-edit the generated Go struct.
2) Plugin ID strings must stay consistent across pkg/services/pluginsintegration/coreplugin/coreplugins.go (the plugin ID constants / NewPlugin switch), the frontend public/app/plugins/datasource/<name>/plugin.json, and — for standalone-capable plugins — the string passed to datasource.Manage(...) in <pkg>/standalone/main.go. pkg/tsdb/Magefile.go greps for these strings to match a Go package to its plugin.json.
3) Wire DI: adding/changing a ProvideService constructor requires updating pkg/server/wire_core.go (and pkg/extensions/enterprise_imports.go / pkg/server/bootstrap/wire/sets.go if enterprise-relevant) and running `make gen-go` to regenerate pkg/server/bootstrap/wire/wire_gen.go.
applies: Applies to the 5 core plugins under pkg/tsdb (azuremonitor, cloudwatch, grafana-testdata-datasource, grafanads, graphite). Does not apply to external/installable plugins which live outside this repo.
